commentary.bulkers: The Kamsarmax "Eternal Bliss" 82/2010 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS 01/2030, DD 01/2028) was committed to Greek interests at high USD 16 mill. For reference, the two-years-older sister vessel "Seaduty" 82/2008 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS 04/2026, DD 11/2025) was sold back in April at USD 14,25 mill. Furthermore, following the sale of "Ultra Lion" 81/2015 Tsuneishi Zhoushan, China (SS 01/2030, DD 01/2028, Scrubber fitted) at USD 24,8 mill in July, Tsuneishi Group have now committed the one-year-younger sister vessel "Ultra Jaguar" 81/2016 Tsuneishi Zhoushan, China (SS/DD 01/2026) to clients of Great Eastern Shipping at low USD 24 mill. On the Ultramax sector, the "DSI Drammen" 63/2016 I-S, Japan (SS/DD 08/2026, Scrubber fitted) was committed at rgn USD 25 mill. Note that a couple of weeks ago, the one-year-younger "Ultra Diversity" 63/2017 Tadotsu, Japan (SS/DD 04/2027, Scrubber fitted) was sold at high USD 26 mill. Moreover, the "Hakata Queen" 60/2016 Mitsui, Japan (SS/DD 01/2026, Scrubber fitted) was committed to Greek interests at USD 23,5 mill. Remind you that the one-year-older sister vessel "Nord Mississippi" 60/2015 Mitsui, Japan (SS/DD 09/2025) was sold back in May at USD 22 mill. The Supramax "Lycavitos" 58/2007 Tsuneishi Cebu, Philippines (SS/DD 03/2027) was committed to Chinese interests at USD 12 mill, while the one- year-younger sister vessel "Jin Rong" 58/2008 Tsuneishi Cebu, Philippines (SS 04/2028, DD 04/2026) was committed to clients of Liuliu Shun Shipping at USD 11,93 mill. For comparison, the sister vessel "Meteora" 58/2007 Tsuneishi Cebu, Philippines (SS/DD 11/2026) was sold recently at USD 11,65 mill. In addition, the "Sagar Kanya" 58/2013 NACKS, China (SS 11/2028, DD 01/2027) was committed to Greek interests at high USD 16 mill. Note that a couple of weeks ago, the one-year-older sister vessel "African Jacana" 58/2012 NACKS, China (SS 10/2027, DD 10/2025) was sold at low USD 16 mill. The semi boxed Handysize "Zudar" 38/2011 Imabari, Japan (SS/DD 01/2026) was committed at low-mid USD 13 mill, while the two-years-younger sister vessel "Sider Olympia" 38/2013 Imabari, Japan (SS 06/2027, DD 09/2025, semi boxed) was sold back in June at USD 15,75 mill. Also, the "Stellar Aragvi" 28/2014 Imabari, Japan (SS 01/2029, DD 02/2026) was committed to Indonesian interests at USD 12,5 mill. Remind you that the sister vessel "Amira Sara" 28/2014 Imabari, Japan (SS 07/2029, DD 06/2027) was sold in June at high USD 11 mill.
commentary.tankers: Avin International have committed their Suezmax "Kriti Vigor" 159/2005 Hyundai, Korea (SS 02/2030, DD 05/2028, Scrubber fitted) at rgn USD 29 mill. For reference, the sister vessel "Concord" 159/2005 Hyundai, Korea (SS/DD 09/2025) was sold a couple of months ago at USD 23,5 mill.
